newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste starts Russia EPS board production.
newsitem.headline: Neste starts Russia EPS board production.

text.p: Finnish oil and chemicals group Neste Oy said in a statement on Thursday it would start in April production of expandable polystyrene (EPS) insulation boards in St Petersburg, Russia.
"The Neste Penoplast company will mainly serve the fast growing construction markets in the St Petersburg area and north-western Russia," it said.

Penoplast's annual output capacity would be over 100,000 cubic metres, Neste said, adding the venture marked the first investment in production by its Chemicals business group. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
